description: This file defines the BasicAccessStrategy class in the OrangeHRM project, which extends AccessStrategy to implement access control logic based on employee number. It provides a method to retrieve access data for a given employee.

classes.name: BasicAccessStrategy
classes.description: A class extending AccessStrategy that implements specific access logic based on employee number.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Retrieves access data for the specified employee number by querying entity records and aggregating their data.
